ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate approximately 75% of the visible surface, with low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated at the trailing edges and in focal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous field on both lobes; dense clusters of dark focal spots (mottling) concentrated on the distal third of the right lobe; dark peripheral banding along the trailing edges of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; the central vertex is partially occluded by water spray, but visible wall convergence suggests a steep angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with variable pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys extending along the entire superior boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced symmetrical concavity from the median notch extending toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density cluster of dark, roughly circular pixel groups localized at the right lobe tip and scattered along the upper margin of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent, multi-directional dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the medial and distal sections of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring across the ventral surface of the left lobe; visible physical wear and irregular notches along the trailing edge topography.
